title: STILL PRESENT (r4): N7 effective-basis fix incomplete — effective_value resurrects the proven-dead snapshot for cleared channels on corrected rows
detail: The r1 W4 rule this same PR implements in the client effective_*, the sweep, and form_handler.effective is corrected-ONLY once correction_cycles >= 1. effective_value ignores the cycles gate: on a cycles>=1 row with a cleared corrected channel, the dead snapshot is resurrected — trio_matches_row can 200-no-op a stale trio reusing the dead value (the N7 silent-drop class remains reachable), and trio_matches can 400 SameReferee on a trio that differs from the row's actual contact.
recommended_fix: Thread correction_cycles into effective_value: snapshot fallback only when correction_cycles == 0 (corrected-only once a correction ran), matching the W4 rule everywhere else.

title: verify_application_in_vacancy DB Error falls into the 404 catch-all instead of a 500
detail: N10 fixed the vacancy-active check's Error arm to a 500, but the outer verify_application_in_vacancy Error arm still matches the `_ -> 404` catch-all: a DB failure reads as "Application not found" (misleading client toast, no Sentry capture). The action does not run (safe), so this is error-class hygiene, not a mutation hole.
recommended_fix: Add an Error(err) arm before the catch-all that logs + returns the branded 500 (db_failure), mirroring the N10 fix one level down.
